# Introduction

The Data Section of the IOTC Secretariat manages, validates and disseminates fisheries data submitted by Contracting Parties and Cooperating Non-Contracting Parties (CPCs), and prepares datasets and supporting information for IOTC Working Parties and the Scientific Committee. It also provides technical assistance to strengthen national data collection, processing and reporting in accordance with IOTC requirements.

This paper provides an overview of the Data Section's activities in 2026, including capacity development, data management and collaboration with partner organisations. It also summarises data-related requests from IOTC meetings and progress on recommendations from WPDCS21. Supporting information is presented in the appendices.
